description: The Canon EOS R50 V with RF-S14-30mm F4-6.3 IS STM PZ Kit – Black is a compact and powerful mirrorless camera designed for creators on the go. Featuring a 24.2MP APS-C sensor, DIGIC X processor, and fast autofocus, it delivers stunning image quality and smooth 4K video. The included RF-S14-30mm power zoom lens offers versatile wide-angle coverage, perfect for vlogging, travel, and everyday moments. With a vari-angle touchscreen, microphone input, and vertical shooting support, it's ideal for content creators looking for performance and portability.
